subject: Request: Promotional POC Credits for HIPAA-bound VPC Evaluation
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@acmepharma.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:05:00Z
Subject: Interest in Private/VPC POC — credits and HIPAA questionnaire

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Acme is very interested in running a HIPAA-bound POC in a customer-managed VPC (Private deployment) to validate connectivity and our protected-data workflows. Two asks from our side: a short extension of promotional credits to cover the Private POC and an initial SOC2/HIPAA checklist so our security team can scope the assessment.

Can Redwood provide a promotional credit allocation for the POC (roughly 2-4 weeks of realistic traffic) and share any security artifacts you have? I attached our HIPAA questionnaire and a draft SOW for the POC.

Timeline: we'd like to start the week of 2026-05-18, pending security sign-off.

Thanks,
Jessica Park
Director, Digital Innovation
Acme Pharmaceuticals

Attachments: Acme_HIPAA_Questionnaire.pdf, POC_SOW_v1.docx

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:02:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Interest in Private/VPC POC — credits and HIPAA questionnaire

Team — forwarding Acme's request. Summary: they need a Private/VPC POC for HIPAA use, want promotional credits to cover POC costs and our security artifacts. They attached a questionnaire and SOW.

Ask: can we (a) offer a conditional credit package for Private POC (customer will deploy in their VPC or our Private offering), and (b) confirm what security artifacts we can share publicly without an NDA? Diego, can you take point on the questionnaire and tell us what evidence is required to sign off quickly?

Suggested commercial: $10k of promotional credits + 2 weeks of engineering support, conditional on NDA + signed SOW. If leadership prefers different numbers, flag. Need quick approval to hit their start date.

Thanks — Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interest in Private/VPC POC — credits and HIPAA questionnaire

Quick review of Acme's questionnaire attached — high level:
- We can share: SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest/in-transit descriptions, key management integrations, Private deployment network model.
- We cannot share customer-specific audit logs or other customers' artifacts.
- For HIPAA workloads in a POC we need: signed NDA, SOW with scope (no PHI retained beyond the POC), and an explicit data handling addendum. Also recommend customers run in their VPC with our Private control plane.

Credit policy: promotional credits may be granted for sales POCs but for Private/VPC evaluations we require legal/finance sign-off for accounting treatment. Ops cost is higher for Private environments. Proposed compromise: approve up to $10k promo credit now, conditional on NDA + SOW + security acknowledgement; final additional credits can be approved after security sign-off.

Attaching: security_evaluation_notes.txt (internal).

- Diego
Security Engineering

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@acmepharma.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Interest in Private/VPC POC — credits and HIPAA questionnaire

Jessica — thanks for the questionnaire and SOW. We can move forward with a conditional promotional credit allocation to get your POC started.

What we can approve today:
- $10,000 promotional credit applied to the POC environment (Private/VPC).
- 1 day of onboarding engineering time and a short runbook for Private deployment.

Conditions:
1) Signed mutual NDA (DocuSign link below).
2) Signed POC SOW (shared with your legal).
3) Security acknowledgement that Acme will run production data safeguards and limit PHI exposure during the POC.

Diego flagged additional artifacts we can share (SOC2 summary, encryption, KMS details). We'll only surface those after the NDA is executed. I'll attach the short approval note for records. If Acme needs more credits for an extended evaluation we can revisit after security completes the checklist.

DocuSign NDA: https://docusign.example/signed/NDA-987654
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/RDW-ACME-2026-001

Attachments: credit_approval_note.txt

Next step: Jessica — can you execute the NDA and return the signed SOW by EOD 2026-05-13? We can provision the Private POC access the following day.

Thanks — Soojin
